name: Hydroponics & Agriculture
description: The ship's green decks — grow-lamps, soil beds, and seed vaults. Well-tended, they turn a rationed voyage into a fed one.
baseline_description: A single ring of grow-lamps and soil beds — enough to stretch the stores, if the harvest holds.

culture_descriptors.label: COMMUNAL HARVEST
culture_descriptors.description: The green decks belong to every table: morale and unity rise, but the living work asks more of the compartment.

culture_descriptors.label: SEEDKEEPERS
culture_descriptors.description: The seed vault is treated as a covenant: craft survives and decay eases, while the crew accepts a quieter harvest.

tiers.name: Aeroponics Suite
tiers.flavor: New grow-lamps and seed stock go in; the green decks come back brighter, and the galley plans a little less anxiously.

tiers.name: Terraced Farmworks
tiers.flavor: The hydroponics are rebuilt across a second ring of decks — the ship now grows more than it strictly must, and the surplus tastes like security.

tiers.name: Closed Ecology
tiers.flavor: The agriculture decks reach their fullest form: closed-loop, self-seeding, abundant. The ship will not go hungry while these decks turn.

name: Schools & Archives
description: Classrooms, libraries, and the rites that carry a craft from a dying hand to a young one. The subsystem that keeps every other subsystem knowable.
baseline_description: A few classrooms and a working library — the founders' knowledge, held one generation at a time.

culture_descriptors.label: OPEN CURRICULUM
culture_descriptors.description: Lessons belong to the whole ship: morale and unity rise, but the archive spends more effort keeping them open.

culture_descriptors.label: SEALED ARCHIVE
culture_descriptors.description: The old record is guarded with discipline: knowledge holds, while the closed doors weigh on the commons.

tiers.name: Founders' Archive
tiers.flavor: New classrooms open and the archives are recopied; a little more of what the founders knew survives another generation.

tiers.name: The Academy
tiers.flavor: The schools are rebuilt into a true academy — apprenticeships, examinations, a craft passed hand to hand on purpose rather than by luck.

tiers.name: Deep Memory Vault
tiers.flavor: The archive becomes the ship's deep memory, redundant and revered; nothing the founders understood need ever be wholly lost again.

name: Engineering Bay
description: Machine shops, spare-part fabricators, and the diagnostic rigs that catch a fault before it becomes a hull breach.
baseline_description: Benches, lathes, and improvised fixes — enough to keep the ship limping, never quite ahead of the rot.

culture_descriptors.label: REPAIR COMMONS
culture_descriptors.description: Every hand learns the fix: morale and craft rise, but the open shop asks the bay to work harder.

culture_descriptors.label: HARDENED SHOP
culture_descriptors.description: The bay becomes a disciplined reserve: longevity improves, while fewer people feel welcome among the machines.

tiers.name: Fabrication Shop
tiers.flavor: New tooling and a proper machine shop go in; the engineers stop improvising and start building.

tiers.name: Fabrication Hall
tiers.flavor: The engineering bay is rebuilt into a full fabrication hall — the ship can now make the parts it once could only ration.

tiers.name: Integrated Foundry
tiers.flavor: The bay reaches its pinnacle: foundry, mill, and clean room together, able to remanufacture nearly anything the ship is made of.

tiers.name: Nanolathe Forge
tiers.flavor: The recovered nanolathe is coaxed back to life: matter reprinted atom by atom, the bay now builds what no shipyard taught it to. No yard sold this — a mission brought it home.

name: Life Support & Habitat
description: Scrubbers, recyclers, and the sealed habitats that stand between the crew and the cold. A stronger habitat wears its life support down slower.
baseline_description: One loop of scrubbers and circulators — the thin, single line between the crew and the cold.

culture_descriptors.label: COMMON AIR
culture_descriptors.description: Air and habitat are held as a shared home: morale and unity rise, but the living deck works harder to stay warm.

culture_descriptors.label: SEALED QUARTERS
culture_descriptors.description: The loops are guarded and redundant: craft improves, while the quieter quarters feel less like a common home.

tiers.name: Overhauled Scrubbers
tiers.flavor: The scrubbers and circulators are overhauled; the air comes easier and the decks feel less like a machine and more like a home.

tiers.name: Dual-Loop Habitat
tiers.flavor: Life support is rebuilt with a second independent loop — a failure that would once have emptied a deck now merely inconveniences it.

tiers.name: Triple-Redundant Biosphere
tiers.flavor: The habitat reaches its fullest: triple-redundant air, water, and warmth. The ship breathes as steadily as a world.

tiers.name: Voidsealed Biosphere
tiers.flavor: Grafted from a dead titan's own habitat decks, the biosphere seals against the void the way its makers meant it to. The ship breathes easier than anything human hands could build it.

name: Medical Bay
description: Surgeries, isolation wards, and gene-clinics. A well-equipped medical deck turns a plague into a scare.
baseline_description: A handful of beds and a tired surgeon — enough for the routine, undone by the outbreak.

culture_descriptors.label: OPEN CLINIC
culture_descriptors.description: Care is visible and shared: morale and unity rise, but the bay spends more of its own strength to keep its doors open.

culture_descriptors.label: TRIAGE DISCIPLINE
culture_descriptors.description: Every treatment follows the reserve ledger: craft holds, while hard choices leave a mark on the commons.

tiers.name: Surgical Ward
tiers.flavor: New surgical kit and clean fields go in; the medics stop losing patients they should have saved.

tiers.name: Ship Hospital
tiers.flavor: The medical bay is rebuilt into a true hospital — wards, a proper theatre, and a pharmacy the ship can actually stock.

tiers.name: Gene-Clinic Complex
tiers.flavor: The bay reaches its pinnacle: gene-clinic, surgical suite, and long-term wards together, a medicine equal to a century in the dark.

name: Security & Peacekeeping
description: Peacekeepers, brig, and the councils that keep a fractious ship from turning on itself. Strong security cools a standoff before it burns.
baseline_description: A volunteer watch and a locked room — order kept by habit, and only just.

culture_descriptors.label: MEDIATED WATCH
culture_descriptors.description: The watch begins with a hearing: unity and morale rise, but mediation takes time and wears the corps.

culture_descriptors.label: HARD WATCH
culture_descriptors.description: Order is made unmistakable: knowledge rises, while the ship pays in trust and ease.

tiers.name: Trained Watch
tiers.flavor: The watch is re-equipped and retrained; the corridors feel safer without feeling watched.

tiers.name: Peacekeeping Service
tiers.flavor: Security is rebuilt into a real peacekeeping service — mediation, patrol, and a jail the ship hopes never to fill.

tiers.name: Standing Guard
tiers.flavor: The peacekeepers reach their fullest form: trusted, restrained, and capable — a force that keeps the peace mostly by being ready to.
